environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 instance running Amazon Linux 2. Logs written to local file /var/log/app/audit.log which is consumed by a log monitoring daemon (ossec) that parses entries line-by-line and triggers alerts based on pattern matching. No input sanitization on log entries. HSM is a SoftHSM2 emulator for development with keys stored in /opt/softhsm/tokens/. Application runs as root user. Log file is also tailed by a custom bash script that executes remediation commands based on log patterns.

config.log_consumer: Custom bash remediation script using eval on parsed fields
